answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the harbor to sunk effort, uses the island as an corroborating signal, then requires a velvet before any payout.
